[9:10 p.m.] #Lekki #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic in and out of Lekki is good.

- Freedom Way in and out is good.
- The Admiralty way in and out is good.
- Lekki - Ikoyi Link Bridge is good;
- Durosimi Etti is good.
- Lekki Toll inwards Lekki 1, Marwa onto Ikate, and Chisco is good.

Our Men are strategically positioned to ensure smooth traffic flow.
